results.description_html:
Objective

Implement the Project Management module for the AI Project Documentation Platform.

This ticket will allow authenticated users to create, view, update, and manage their documentation projects and project requirements. It will also implement the project lifecycle state machine, ensuring that projects can move only through valid states.

All project operations must be user-specific, so a user can access and modify only their own projects and related resources. Pasted text

results.name: Event & Ticket Booking Microservice
results.description_html:
Description

Develop a small Event & Ticket Booking Microservice using Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL/MongoDB, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, and Docker.

The service should provide CRUD functionality for Events, Seats, and Bookings, along with basic validation, database relationships, error handling, API documentation, testing, and Dockerization.

Requirements

  • Set up a FastAPI-based microservice.

  • Integrate PostgreSQL using SQLAlchemy.

  • Implement Alembic database migrations.

  • Implement CRUD operations for:

    • Events

    • Seats

    • Bookings

  • Implement basic request validation.

  • Maintain appropriate relationships between Event, Seat, and Booking.

  • Prevent booking of an already-booked seat.

  • Implement basic error handling and appropriate HTTP status codes.

  • Dockerize the application using Dockerfile and Docker Compose.

  • Verify APIs through Swagger/Postman.

  • Add basic automated tests.

  • Provide a README containing setup, API usage, and Docker instructions.

Expected Deliverables

  • Complete source code

  • PostgreSQL database integration

  • Alembic migrations

  • Working CRUD APIs

  • Dockerfile

  • Docker Compose configuration

  • Postman collection

  • Basic test cases

  • README documentation

Acceptance Criteria

  • Application starts successfully using Docker Compose.

  • PostgreSQL connection works correctly.

  • Event CRUD APIs work.

  • Seat CRUD APIs work.

  • Booking CRUD APIs work.

  • Basic validation and error handling are implemented.

  • Already-booked seats cannot be booked again.

  • Database migrations are available.

  • APIs are accessible through Swagger.

  • Postman collection is provided.

  • Basic tests are implemented and passing.

  • README contains complete setup and usage instructions.

Reference

Refer to the Event & Ticket Booking Microservice — Project Requirements document for the detailed functional and technical requirements.
